authorityBoundary: append-only storage of accounting authority/evidence emitted by @mycelix/accounting

qualification.purpose: reproduce the committed JavaScript dependency graph
qualify the semantic authority that derives persistence records

qualification.command: npm run db:generate --workspace=@mycelix/database && npm run db:validate --workspace=@mycelix/database
qualification.purpose: generate and validate the committed authority schema

qualification.command: npm run db:push --workspace=@mycelix/database -- --skip-generate && npm run db:accounting-guards --workspace=@mycelix/database
qualification.purpose: deploy the schema into ephemeral PostgreSQL and install append-only triggers
prove every authority/evidence table accepts append but rejects UPDATE and DELETE at the database layer
prevent legacy payment authority and append-only schema regressions

qualification.command: npm run type-check:accounting-authority --workspace=@mycelix/database && npm run test:accounting-authority --workspace=@mycelix/database
qualification.purpose: qualify idempotent append/replay and statement conservation semantics

qualification.command: npm run type-check:accounting-authority --workspace=@mycelix/database && npm run test:accounting-authority --workspace=@mycelix/database && npm run test:accounting-guards --workspace=@mycelix/database
qualification.purpose: verify Ed25519-backed checkpoint acceptance, current-head idempotency, stale checkpoint rejection, source/batch identity continuity, allocation/link-root prefix preservation in both application and PostgreSQL cursor guards, serializable cursor compare-and-swap, exact cursor-to-evidence binding, revision-one initialization, root-replay rejection, idle observation-coverage advancement without HWM change, exact decimal HWM comparisons beyond JavaScript safe integers, timestamp monotonicity, no-progress rejection, immutable evidence, and rejection of UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE reset paths

promotionRule: Every qualification item must succeed against the exact proposed head, including live PostgreSQL mutation rejection. Missing, queued, skipped, stale, synthetic-merge-only, schema-only, unit-only, or ancestor evidence is not PASS.
forbiddenClaims: Prisma schema validation proves append-only runtime enforcement.
Application code without database guards makes authority rows immutable.
A caller-supplied digest is authoritative merely because it is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
A RoyaltyPayment row is royalty debt authority.
A deterministic netting batch is a second ledger.
Queued or absent exact-head workflow evidence is PASS.
A valid checkpoint signature alone prevents durable rollback without a persistent monotonic cursor.
A later timestamp or higher source cursor is sufficient if a checkpoint omits previously accepted allocation or successor-link roots.
A row-level append-only trigger prevents an authorized database role from resetting checkpoint history with TRUNCATE.
